# ToolGraft

> Free, open-source website adapters from Particular Labs. Bring your own agent;
> ToolGraft provides no internal AI. This checkout is a local developer preview.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): Current capabilities and how to choose the right workflow.
- [Agent setup](docs/agent-setup.md): Current MCP configuration and actual external-model evidence.
- [Authoring skill](skills/toolgraft-authoring/SKILL.md): Portable creation and repair instructions with explicit capability checks.
- [Authoring](docs/authoring.md): Guided MCP creation/repair and optional CLI/package workflow.

## Compatibility and product design

- [Client compatibility](docs/agent-compatibility.md): Hermes, OpenClaw, Grok and local/cloud connection distinctions.
- [Guided authoring design](docs/guided-authoring-design.md): Local guided authoring design and remaining acceptance cases.
- [Authenticated sites and cloud](docs/authenticated-sites-and-cloud.md): Browser sessions, OAuth and remote transports.
- [Project status](docs/project-status.md): Current capabilities, validation commands and limitations.

Links are relative to this repository. No public website publication or automatic
client discovery of this file is claimed.
